title: The constructible topology of a spectral space is quasi-compact
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space]. Then $X$ endowed with its constructible topology [def-weil-pbc-constructible-topology] (the topology with subbase the quasi-compact open subsets of $X$ and their complements) is quasi-compact: every covering of $X$ by subsets that are open in the constructible topology has a finite subcovering.
